event: CME and type II burst of 2024-05-09 (X1.1 flare, AR 13664; Mother's Day storm)
gcs_note: gcs_wl: fit at 17:55 UT to COR1-A and COR2-A with the direction fixed at the flare S14W28 (IoU COR1-A 0.878). gcs at 17:32 UT keeps that shape; its apex height of 1.77 R_sun is assumed, not measured (COR1-A shows no rising front for this CME), and follows from a constant speed of about 985 km/s between the flare onset at 17:23 UT (apex at about 1 R_sun) and the 17:55 UT fit (3.722 R_sun).
